reproducibility.dataset_identity: complete exact-identity eligibility closure of nq_open/validation[512:3610] under protected434+historical100+spent256 exclusions

trace_contract.sample_selection_rule: no sampling: include the complete exact-identity eligible closure, then deterministically alternate a frozen hash order into split_A/split_B
trace_contract.target_boundary: no answers, labels, generations, semantic judgments or method outcomes reach retrieval/scoring; reviewers see no method, score, rank or answer fields
required_representations: all three score vectors and Top5 sets
producer_owned_lineage: NQ interval -> exact exposure exclusion -> complete identity lock -> balanced A/B lock -> Wiki-DPR Top50 -> three-arm scores -> sealed blind reviews -> unblinded metrics
readiness_checks: both consensus hashes before key unseal

full_real_data_l2.formal_data_scope: Every eligible untouched question in nq_open/validation[512:3610] after the three frozen exact-hash exclusions, with its fixed Wiki-DPR Top50
full_real_data_l2.data_exposure_policy: Freeze exhaustive identities and A/B membership before scoring; freeze scores before semantic review; keep both method keys sealed until both split consensuses are complete
full_real_data_l2.l4_attribution_plan: Report matched-classical gates separately; only after they pass may a new protocol add finite-shot implementation checks and explicit state-preparation, gate, measurement, readout and runtime accounting

recovery_contract.discriminating_intermediate_measurement: Before semantic review, emit complete split-specific changed-set rates and exact quantum/classical Top5 difference rates while all semantic targets remain sealed

limitations: The exact realized case count is intentionally derived only when the collaborator scans the complete pinned dataset; the deterministic rule, bounds and exclusions are already frozen
Independent A/B splits test data robustness within one natural source, not cross-dataset transfer
Semantic evidence retention evaluates the selector boundary and does not establish Generator answer accuracy
Even a complete-data L2 pass cannot establish quantum-specific value without the separately frozen matched-control, finite-shot and resource audits
The population freezer/exporter is implemented and synthetic-tested, but no real cohort trace, score, review or formal result exists yet
